events.title: PWPL Presents: 1-ON-1 Tech Coaching for Seniors
events.description: Tuesday, October (6, 13, 20 & 27), 2026 10:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. Peter White Public Library, Local History Research Room. Need help with the settings on your phone or iPad? Want to download travel apps before you leave town? Need help utilizing the library’s Memory Lab or navigating Libby? Learn how to make your electronic devices work the way you want, with the help of Christine Ault, retired teacher and teach coach, Tuesday mornings from 10 AM – 3 PM in the Local History Research Room of the Peter White Public Library. Call the Reference Desk at 906-226-4311 to schedule a 30-minute session. Please charge your electronic device and have your questions prepared before each session. Bring your passwords and pins as needed.

events.title: PWPL Presents: All Booked Up: On Air
events.description: Wednesday, October 28, 2026. 9:00 a.m.-10:00 a.m. WLUC TV 6 Studios. Adults, Seniors, Family Friendly. Join Upper Michigan Today’s John Redfield and Audrey Stetson, along with PWPL staff, for an on-air, in-person book discussion. This month’s book: Vigil by: George Saudners. No admission charge. For more information, contact Marty at 226-4322, machatz@pwpl.info , or visit pwpl.info .

events.title: PWPL Presents: ‘Twas the Night Before Halloween Storytime
events.description: Friday, October 30, 2026. 6:00 p.m. – 6:30 p.m. Peter White Public Library Community Room. Join us for our annual family-friendly storytime! Costumes for all highly encouraged as participants enjoy this interactive storytime with stories, songs, a costume parade and trick-or- treating on your way out! Children of all ages are welcome; caregivers are expected to attend storytime with their children. Important – this storytime is taking place after hours. The library doors will close at 5:30pm and re-open for storytime attendees only at 5:45pm. The kids’ room will NOT be open during storytime and library services will NOT be available. No admission charge. For more information and to check the status of the program, call 906-226-4323 or visit pwpl.info .

events.title: PWPL Presents: 1-ON-1 Tech Coaching for Seniors
events.description: Tuesday, November (3, 10, 17 & 24), 2026 10:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. Peter White Public Library Local History Research Room. Need help with the settings on your phone or iPad? Want to download travel apps before you leave town? Need help utilizing the library’s Memory Lab or navigating Libby? Learn how to make your electronic devices work the way you want, with the help of Christine Ault, retired teacher and teach coach, Tuesday mornings from 10 AM – 3 PM during June, July and August in the Local History Research Room of the Peter White Public Library. Call the Reference Desk at 906-226-4311 to schedule a 30-minute session. Please charge your electronic device and have your questions prepared before each session. Bring your passwords and pins as needed.

events.title: PWPL Presents: Little Illustrators Book Club: Jon Klassen
events.description: Tuesday, November 3, 2026. 4:30 p.m. – 5:30 p.m. Peter White Public Library Great Room. For children ages 5-7 with a loving adult. Little Illustrators introduces the artists behind favorite picture books. Each month youth will enjoy a read-aloud story, participate in a staff-led discussion/investigation of the illustrator’s unique style, and create their own piece of take-home artwork inspired by the techniques and materials used by the illustrator. In November, we will explore the art style of Jon Klassen! No admission charge. For more information and to check the status of the program, call 906-226-4323 or visit pwpl.info .

events.title: PWPL Presents: Writers on Writing: Jesse Koenig
events.description: Wednesday, November 4, 2026. 6:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m., Peter White Public Library Shiras Room. Adults, Seniors, Teens. In this programming series, seasoned published authors of various genres lead participants through writing exercises and workshops to hone their writerly talents. November’s Writer: Jesse Koenig. Jesse Koenig is currently serving as U.P. Poet Laureate, and he has published the poetry/flash fiction collection Brief Perversions. In this session, Jesse will lead participants through writing prompts designed to inspire the sublime and irreverent. Space is limited to 15 participants, so register early. No admission charge. For more information, contact Marty at 226-4322, machatz@pwpl.info , or visit pwpl.info .

events.title: Small Business Celebration 2026
events.description: The Lake Superior Community Partnership is excited to host the third annual Marquette County Small Business Celebration on Thursday, November 5, at the Mather. This special event will honor and recognize small businesses across Marquette County, as well as an individual who will be named the Small Business Champion for their outstanding support of local businesses. Enjoy heavy appetizers and a cash bar throughout the evening. Nominate a business or individual for the Small Business AwardsNominations for the Small Business Awards will close on September 25.Interested in Sponsoring? Find out ...

events.title: PWPL Presents: Marquette Poets Circle
events.description: Thursday, November 5, 2026, 6:30 p.m.-8:00 p.m. Peter White Public Library Heritage Room. Adults, Seniors, Family Friendly. Join local poets, writers, and poetry enthusiasts for an evening of poetry. Starting at 6:30 p.m., participants gather to workshop their current work, followed by an Open Mic at 7:15 p.m. New and experienced poets are welcome for either or both events. No admission charge. For more information, contact Marty at 226-4322, machatz@pwpl.info , or visit pwpl.info .

events.title: LSSU Home Hockey Game
events.description: Cheer on the Lake Superior State University Lakers as they return to the ice at Taffy Abel Arena for the 2026–27 season! Fast-paced college hockey, longtime traditions, and plenty of Laker spirit make every home game an exciting experience for fans of all ages. The Lakers compete in NCAA Division I hockey as a member of the Central Collegiate Hockey Association (CCHA). With a storied history that includes multiple national championships, Laker Hockey remains an important part of Sault Ste. Marie’s sports culture. Learn more about the team and view the complete season schedule at LSSU Athletics . For a schedule of home opponents, see below. October 23 – vs. Bowling Green – 7:07 p.m. 24 – vs. Bowling Green – 7:07 p.m. November 5 – vs. Maryville University – 7:07 p.m. 6 – vs. Maryville University – 6:07 p.m. 20 – vs. Bemidji State University – 7:07 p.m. 21 – vs. Bemidji State University – 6:07 p.m. December 11 – vs. Minnesota State – 7:07 p.m. 12 – vs. Minnesota State – 7:07 p.m. January 15 – vs. Northern Michigan University – 7:07 p.m. 16 – vs. Northern Michigan University – 6:07 p.m. 29 – vs. Michigan Tech – 7:07 p.m. 30 – vs. Michigan Tech – 6:07 p.m. February 19 – vs. Ferris State University – 7:07 p.m. 20 – vs. Ferris State University – 7:07 p.m. All listed games take place at Taffy Abel Arena. Dates and times are based on the official LSSU Athletics schedule and are subject to change.

events.title: Laker Preview Day (Virtual)
events.description: Laker Preview Day is a chance for prospective students and their families to experience what it’s like to be a Laker without having to travel to campus. Guests can explore campus resources, learn about academic programs, meet faculty and current students, and see the resources and opportunities available at LSSU. The day will also include information about admissions, financial aid, scholarships, housing, and the next steps for joining the Laker community. This session will be held virtually. Register here or through the URL listed below. The registration period closes Thursday, November 5, 2026. Go Lakers!

This is a casual networking opportunity that's held at some of Marquette County's most interesting locations and businesses. Whether you're a seasoned networker or just getting started, all are welcome—partnership members and non-members alike.
